lines.zh: 我一步一顿，像被自己的刺绊住。
lines.en: I lurch step by step, snagged on my own thorns.

lines.zh: 走过沙地，我留下一串尖痕。
lines.en: Crossing the sand, I leave a line of sharp marks.

lines.zh: 菌染尸壳的旧关节还在响。
lines.en: The old husk joints still creak as I move.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，刺却不慢。
lines.en: I move slowly, but the thorns do not.

lines.zh: 草叶碰到我，立刻枯了一截。
lines.en: Grass touches me and withers along that stretch.

lines.zh: 我沿墙根挪，磨掉一层石灰。
lines.en: I scrape along the wall, shaving off the lime.

lines.zh: 每走一步，背上就多一声脆响。
lines.en: Each step adds a crisp click along my back.

lines.zh: 我绕开积水，刺沾水会变重。
lines.en: I skirt the puddles; wet thorns grow heavy.

lines.zh: 小路上有羊，它们自己让开。
lines.en: Sheep on the path step aside without being asked.

lines.zh: 我的影子像一丛移动的枯枝。
lines.en: My shadow looks like a walking thicket of dead branches.

lines.zh: 我朝亮处走，刺尖泛着灰光。
lines.en: I walk toward the light; my thorn tips gleam gray.

lines.zh: 走进村子，篱笆开始扎手。
lines.en: Entering the village, the fences start to prickle.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，刺尖滴下一点菌液。
lines.en: I stand still while fungus drips from my thorn tips.

lines.zh: 风穿过我的刺，发出细小的哨音。
lines.en: Wind threads my spines into a thin whistling.

lines.zh: 我在等皮肤彻底硬透。
lines.en: I am waiting for my hide to harden all the way.

lines.zh: 身上这层壳比尸壳时厚了三分。
lines.en: This shell is three parts thicker than my husk days.

lines.zh: 有只鸟落在背上，又急忙飞走。
lines.en: A bird lands on my back and flees at once.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，但还是会停住。
lines.en: I need no breath, yet I still pause to take one.

lines.zh: 刺之间积了薄薄一层沙。
lines.en: A thin layer of sand gathers between my spines.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抖了抖，沙落了一地。
lines.en: I shake myself slowly and sand falls everywhere.

lines.zh: 日头把我的壳晒得发烫。
lines.en: The sun bakes my shell until it is hot.

lines.zh: 我记不清做尸壳时在想什么。
lines.en: I cannot recall what I thought as a husk.

lines.zh: 远处有人在砍树，我听着。
lines.en: Someone chops wood far off; I listen.

lines.zh: 我的刺一天比一天长一点。
lines.en: My thorns grow a little longer every day.

lines.zh: 站久了，脚下的土被刺扎松。
lines.en: Standing this long, my thorns loosen the soil.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛要看的东西。
lines.en: There is nothing my eyes need to look at.

lines.zh: 有东西撞上我的刺，又退开了。
lines.en: Something hits my spines, then backs away.

lines.zh: 我的刺尖上挂着一点旧血。
lines.en: A bit of old blood hangs on my spines.

lines.zh: 雨落到我身上，顺着刺往下淌。
lines.en: Rain falls on me and runs down the spines.

lines.zh: 我不动，是让菌丝先把地铺好。
lines.en: I stay still so the mycelium can lay the ground.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，刺先对准你的手。
lines.en: I raise my head and my thorns aim at your hands.

lines.zh: 你看我的壳，我也看你的剑。
lines.en: You study my shell; I study your sword.

lines.zh: 我在算你这一剑会落在哪根刺上。
lines.en: I am working out which thorn your blade will hit.

lines.zh: 你靠近一步，我的刺长了半寸。
lines.en: You come a step closer and my spines extend half an inch.

lines.zh: 你的护甲很亮，敲上去会响。
lines.en: Your armor is bright; it will ring when struck.

lines.zh: 我看你握剑的手，指节发白。
lines.en: I watch your sword hand, knuckles pale.

lines.zh: 你不像尸壳，你还知道疼。
lines.en: You are no husk; you still know pain.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，刺刮过自己的肩。
lines.en: I tilt my head and a thorn scrapes my own shoulder.

lines.zh: 你盯着我的关节，那是我最软处。
lines.en: You stare at my joints, my softest place.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，让你先动手。
lines.en: I shift back half a step and let you swing first.

lines.zh: 你的火把照出我满身的尖。
lines.en: Your torch lights up every point on me.

lines.zh: 你笑了，我不明白笑什么。
lines.en: You smile; I do not understand at what.

lines.zh: 剑砍在壳上，你的手先麻了。
lines.en: Your blade hits my shell and your hand numbs first.

lines.zh: 这一下我记着，反弹会还给你。
lines.en: I keep this blow in mind; the rebound will repay it.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道，菌丝立刻填进来。
lines.en: A crack opens and fungus threads fill it at once.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，刺扎进土里。
lines.en: I step back and my thorns dig into the soil.

lines.zh: 四十点生命不算少，你再试试。
lines.en: Forty points of life is not little; try again.

lines.zh: 疼是钝的，像隔着厚布。
lines.en: The pain is dull, as if through heavy cloth.

lines.zh: 你砍断两根刺，它们落在地上。
lines.en: You shear two thorns and they drop to the ground.

lines.zh: 我的壳屑混着灰血掉下来。
lines.en: Shell flakes fall mixed with gray blood.

lines.zh: 这一击让我的肩歪了。
lines.en: That blow left my shoulder crooked.

lines.zh: 我低声响了一下，又站直了。
lines.en: I rasp once and straighten up again.

lines.zh: 你递来腐肉，我闻了闻就推开。
lines.en: You offer rotten flesh; I sniff and push it away.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，菌替我活着。
lines.en: I do not eat; the fungus lives for me.

lines.zh: 你把面包掰开，碎屑掉在地上。
lines.en: You break the bread and crumbs fall to the ground.

lines.zh: 靠近我的人，通常都带着伤。
lines.en: People who come near me usually bring wounds.

lines.zh: 我不追你，我等着你撞上来。
lines.en: I do not chase; I wait for you to blunder in.

lines.zh: 你的好意扎手，比我的刺还扎。
lines.en: Your kindness stings worse than my thorns.

lines.zh: 我只想要你身上那点体温。
lines.en: I only want the little warmth your body holds.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下就走，很好。
lines.en: You set it down and leave; good.

lines.zh: 我不懂喂食，只懂反弹。
lines.en: I understand nothing of feeding, only rebounding.

lines.zh: 你再靠近，刺会自己动。
lines.en: Come closer and the thorns will move on their own.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，先疼的是你自己。
lines.en: You bump into me, and you are the first to hurt.

lines.zh: 我的刺划开你的袖子，很浅。
lines.en: My spines slit your sleeve, shallowly.

lines.zh: 这一下我退了，你也没讨到好。
lines.en: I give ground, and you gained nothing by it.

lines.zh: 我的壳撞你的盾，声音发闷。
lines.en: My shell hits your shield with a muffled knock.

lines.zh: 别贴着我，反弹不分敌我。
lines.en: Do not press against me; the rebound spares no one.

lines.zh: 我们挤在门口，你先松了劲。
lines.en: We jam the doorway and your push gives out first.

lines.zh: 你的手按在我背上，立刻缩回。
lines.en: Your hand lands on my back and snaps away.

lines.zh: 碰撞让两根刺断在你身上。
lines.en: The clash leaves two broken spines in you.

lines.zh: 我身上掉下细碎的灰色壳屑。
lines.en: Fine gray shell flakes fall off me.

lines.zh: 你退开时，地上有几点血。
lines.en: When you pull back, there are drops of blood.

lines.zh: 菌染的生物很少需要成对。
lines.en: Infected things rarely need to pair off.

lines.zh: 我的刺会把靠近的同类也划伤。
lines.en: My thorns cut even kin that come close.

lines.zh: 繁殖靠孢子，不靠亲近。
lines.en: Propagation comes from spores, not from closeness.

lines.zh: 你要靠近，先问问我的壳。
lines.en: If you want to come near, ask my shell first.

lines.zh: 我做尸壳时也没人敢碰我。
lines.en: No one dared touch me even as a husk.

lines.zh: 同族之间保持一根刺的距离。
lines.en: Kin keep a thorn's length apart.

lines.zh: 新的荆刺者从我的残壳里长。
lines.en: New Verdathorns grow from my broken shell.

lines.zh: 我没有软的地方给人靠。
lines.en: I have no soft side for anyone to lean on.

lines.zh: 你把剑放下，我也不会放下刺。
lines.en: Put your sword down; I still will not lower my thorns.

lines.zh: 离我远点，这是我能给的好意。
lines.en: Stay back; that is the kindness I can offer.

lines.zh: 我弯不下腰，只能把东西挑起来。
lines.en: I cannot bend, so I hook things up on a thorn.

lines.zh: 一块铁我穿在刺上带走了。
lines.en: I spear a piece of iron on a spine and carry it.

lines.zh: 捡到的东西多半会扎破。
lines.en: Most things I pick up end up punctured.

lines.zh: 我挑起你的头盔，挂回背上。
lines.en: I lift your helmet and hang it on my back.

lines.zh: 地上的腐肉我不碰，菌会处理。
lines.en: I leave the rotten flesh; the fungus will deal with it.

lines.zh: 这面盾我用刺夹着走。
lines.en: I carry this shield clamped between my thorns.

lines.zh: 拾起种子时，袋子先破了。
lines.en: When I pick up the seeds, the bag tears first.

lines.zh: 我把一把箭折成刺的样子。
lines.en: I snap a handful of arrows into spiny shapes.

lines.zh: 东西挂在我身上，很快就锈。
lines.en: Whatever hangs on me rusts quickly.

lines.zh: 我捡它，只是因为它太整齐。
lines.en: I pick it up only because it looks too neat.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，壳上的刺全立起来。
lines.en: I see you and every spine on my shell rises.

lines.zh: 你砍我一下，会比自己想的疼。
lines.en: One cut from you will hurt more than you think.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，把正面朝向你。
lines.en: I turn slowly and present my front to you.

lines.zh: 目标很近，近到刺能碰到。
lines.en: The target is near enough for my thorns to touch.

lines.zh: 你的剑砍下来时，我会算好角度。
lines.en: When your blade comes down, I have my angle set.

lines.zh: 我不追，我等你自己送上门。
lines.en: I do not chase; I wait for you to deliver yourself.

lines.zh: 护甲十点，你的剑要砍很久。
lines.en: Ten points of armor; your sword will need many swings.

lines.zh: 我选上你，因为你站得最近。
lines.en: I choose you because you stand nearest.

lines.zh: 这一战你会记住反弹的滋味。
lines.en: You will remember the taste of rebound after this.

lines.zh: 我的刺开始一下一下地颤。
lines.en: My thorns begin to quiver, one after another.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，把刺尖朝前。
lines.en: I lower my body and point the thorn tips forward.

lines.zh: 你换位置，我跟着转半圈。
lines.en: You change position and I rotate half a turn.

lines.zh: 我在等你出剑，那才是空隙。
lines.en: I am waiting for your swing; that is the opening.

lines.zh: 你往左，我的刺往左。
lines.en: You go left, and my thorns go left.

lines.zh: 我不出声，只让壳发出细响。
lines.en: I make no sound, only a thin rasp from my shell.

lines.zh: 距离刚好够我挨你一击。
lines.en: The distance is just enough for me to take one hit.

lines.zh: 你抬手时，我把肩顶出去。
lines.en: When you raise your hand, I push my shoulder out.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上慢慢伸长。
lines.en: My shadow lengthens slowly across the ground.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，刺也不必藏了。
lines.en: You back into the corner; the thorns need hiding no more.

lines.zh: 再近两步，你就自己撞上来了。
lines.en: Two steps closer and you will walk into them yourself.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，刺替你数了伤口。
lines.en: I ram you once and the thorns count your wounds.

lines.zh: 七点伤害，我的壳比手更硬。
lines.en: Seven points of damage; my shell hits harder than my hand.

lines.zh: 我用手臂扫过去，尖先到。
lines.en: I sweep my arm across, and the points arrive first.

lines.zh: 你挡住这一下，刺还是划到你。
lines.en: You block the blow, but the spines still rake you.

lines.zh: 我顶着盾往前推，刺在盾后。
lines.en: I push into your shield, thorns curled behind it.

lines.zh: 你砍中我的壳，反震传回你手上。
lines.en: You strike my shell and the shock returns to your hand.

lines.zh: 我一头撞在你胸口，壳屑乱飞。
lines.en: I butt your chest and shell flakes fly.

lines.zh: 你踉跄时，我的第二下跟上了。
lines.en: As you stagger, my second blow follows.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我的刺全都够得着。
lines.en: At this range, every thorn of mine can reach you.

lines.zh: 别拿拳头打我，你会先流血。
lines.en: Do not punch me; you will bleed first.

lines.zh: 尸壳的皮裂开，刺从缝里顶出来。
lines.en: The husk's hide splits and thorns push through the seams.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看到的世界是灰的。
lines.en: The first world I see is gray.

lines.zh: 沙从我的关节里簌簌落下。
lines.en: Sand sifts out of my joints.

lines.zh: 我试着走一步，刺扎进自己的腿。
lines.en: I try one step and a thorn stabs my own leg.

lines.zh: 这具身体比我记得的更重。
lines.en: This body is heavier than I remember.

lines.zh: 我站起来的瞬间，周围草枯了。
lines.en: The instant I rise, the grass around me dies.

lines.zh: 有人在远处看见我，转身就跑。
lines.en: Someone sees me in the distance and runs.

lines.zh: 我的刺在出生时就长齐了。
lines.en: My thorns were fully grown at birth.

lines.zh: 我听见菌丝在壳里拉紧的声音。
lines.en: I hear the threads tightening inside my shell.

lines.zh: 尸壳的记忆只剩下沙。
lines.en: All that remains of the husk's memory is sand.

lines.zh: 我挪动两步，地上留下浅坑。
lines.en: I shuffle two steps, leaving shallow pits.

lines.zh: 三十个人里，只有一个会变成我。
lines.en: Of thirty, only one becomes what I am.

lines.zh: 火把刺尖烧红，壳里冒出焦味。
lines.en: The flames redden my spines and my shell smells scorched.

lines.zh: 落地时刺先着地，折断了一片。
lines.en: Landing thorn-first, a whole patch snaps off.

lines.zh: 水没过壳，刺上挂满气泡。
lines.en: Water closes over my shell and bubbles cling to the spines.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀掉我半边刺，壳还在。
lines.en: The blast strips half my thorns; the shell remains.

lines.zh: 箭插在刺缝里，我懒得拔。
lines.en: An arrow sticks between my spines; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 魔法的光沿刺尖流，壳在发抖。
lines.en: Magic runs along the spine tips and my shell shivers.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，壳靠菌维持着。
lines.en: I eat nothing; the fungus sustains my shell.

lines.zh: 雷劈中我，所有刺一起发亮。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and every thorn lights up at once.

lines.zh: 虚空吞掉我的下半截，刺还在飘。
lines.en: The void takes my lower half; the thorns still drift.
